limitations: Conditional candidate-verification replay. Article sets were discovered through declared publication alternates or a Baltic news headline search, not recovered by end-to-end network discovery. Missing baselines, account ages and mutuals cannot fire. English-edition and search-retrieval selection limit generalisation. Some reporting controls do not meet the minimum sample. Only Pravda is replayed; the other documented families lack retrievable timestamped post sets. No public-debunk lead pairs verified.
